description: Configure a scheduled sync from an external provider INTO a database, and start it running. CREDENTIALS NEVER PASS THROUGH THIS TOOL: the account is connected once in the app (Settings → Connections) and referenced by `connection_id` (from list_connections, or from list_sources). list_source_providers and discover_source_fields describe what a provider offers; field_mapping maps provider keys to this database's fields, and external_key_field (one of its targets) is what makes a re-sync update instead of duplicate. Covers field_mapping directions, conflict_policy, write_back and push approval, defaults. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES create_source"]

config.description: Provider config; shape is in list_source_providers' config_schema. May also set conflict_policy: "external_wins" (default) | "storyos_wins" | "newest_wins".

connection_id.description: Id of the stored connection to sync through. NOT a credential — see this tool's description for where it comes from.

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id — the sync TARGET.

external_key_field.description: Field (name or id) holding the provider's stable id. Must be one of field_mapping's target fields.

field_mapping.description: { "provider_external_key": "field name or id" } for a pull-only mapping (the common case), or { "provider_external_key": { field, direction } } — direction "in" (default), "out" (push-only, never overwritten by a sync), or "both". discover_source_fields returns a proposed_field_mapping in this shape.

name.description: A human label for this source, e.g. "Shopify orders".

recurrence.description: Exact cadence, and it wins over `schedule`: {kind:"hourly",minute} | {kind:"daily",hour,minute} | {kind:"weekly",weekday,hour,minute}.

schedule.description: Coarse cadence. Omit to get the default daily sync, or pass `recurrence` for an exact time.
